description: Angular component for wind speed and direction widget settings in a weather-related dashboard, including form handling, layout options, and preview functionality.

classes.name: WindSpeedDirectionWidgetSettingsComponent
classes.description: Angular component managing settings for wind speed and direction widget, including layout, colors, fonts, and data source configurations.

methods.name: hasCenterValue
methods.description: Checks if the widget has a center data key configured.

methods.name: majorTicksFontEnabled
methods.description: Determines if major ticks font options should be enabled based on layout.

methods.name: minorTicksFontEnabled
methods.description: Determines if minor ticks font options should be enabled based on layout.

methods.name: settingsForm
methods.description: Returns the form group managing widget settings.

methods.name: onSettingsSet
methods.description: Initializes form controls with provided widget settings.

methods.name: validatorTriggers
methods.description: Returns form control names that trigger validation updates.

methods.name: updateValidators
methods.description: Enables or disables form controls based on current layout.

methods.name: _centerValuePreviewFn
methods.description: Generates a preview string for the center value, formatted with units and decimals.
